I help Grandma get off the bus.
My little brother was crying, so I helped him up.
I often go to the park with Grandma.
It often rains in the afternoon.
I like playing with balls.
My ball is missing.
I am playing ball with my big brother.
After class we go to play ball.
The earth is round.
I love our earth.
I have a pair of white sports shoes.
My older brother's sports shoes are really smelly!
We play football on the grass.

s.zh: 爸爸给我买了一个足球。
s.en: Dad bought me a football.
My little brother can walk a few steps now.
Grandpa takes very small steps.
Dad goes running every morning.
My older brother and I jog in the park.
Your Chinese has improved!
The teacher said I have made progress.
This book has lots of pictures.
I drew a picture for Mum.
Dad is looking at the map.
This is a map of our school.
The teacher shows us pictures.
I like looking at pictures of animals.
There is a cat in my drawing.
This picture book is really nice.
We study at school.

s.zh: 我和同学一起学习中文。
s.en: My classmates and I learn Chinese together.
The puppy is my good companion.
My pals and I play in the park.
Fish swim around in the river.
The duckling swims in the water.
We go to the park to have fun.

s.zh: 星期天我们去动物园游玩。
s.en: On Sunday we go to the zoo for fun.
Everyone claps together.
Mum pats me on the head.
My racket is red.
My older brother's racket is broken.
I am very happy today.

s.zh: 妈妈看到我的画，很高兴。
s.en: Mum was very happy to see my drawing.
Let's play a game!
After class we play games.
We are going to watch the circus.
There is an elephant in the circus.
